notes: Residual Effectiveness v2.1 on the same K = 9 labels. B(h) is the frozen baseline: base Qwen3-8B with the LoRA adapters switched off and the frozen-backbone baseline's head, never trained, so P(success | h) is exactly the baseline's. G(h, r) = e uses the LoRA adapters and a residual head that starts at 0. P(success | h, r) = sigmoid(b + e), delta = sigmoid(b + e) - sigmoid(b). Loss on AFTER examples only: binomial NLL + ranking.lambda * same-history pairwise ranking loss (pairs whose rollout AFTER rates differ by at least 2/9) + residual.regularization * mean(e^2). BEFORE NLL is monitored, not optimized.

predictor.pilot_decision: 2026-10-01 user decision: residual predictor with a truly frozen B branch (v2.1), after v2 showed that detaching b does not keep B fixed when B and G share the LoRA-updated backbone

training.training_notes: learning_rate is the residual head's rate, lora_learning_rate the adapter rate. init_head_from is the frozen baseline whose head is B. frozen_before_baseline_logits: that baseline's DEV logits, compared with B before training. Batches hold the AFTER examples of whole histories. Every epoch's checkpoint is kept.
